name: brewpage
description: Publish HTML, Markdown, files and multi-file static sites from Codex to BrewPage, a hosted service that returns an HTTPS link with no account or API key; via the brewpage-publish skill and the BrewPage remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Publish HTML, Markdown, files and sites to a shareable link
interface.longDescription: BrewPage turns something Codex produced (an HTML report, a Markdown document, a file or a small static site) into an HTTPS link. Publishing needs no account or API key. Pages are unlisted by default and expire after 1 to 30 days; the public namespace lists them in a gallery. The plugin bundles the brewpage-publish skill, which asks for namespace and password before upload, gives you the page link and its private management link and keeps owner tokens in a private local history file, and connects the BrewPage remote MCP server. BrewPage itself is a hosted, closed-source service; this plugin is MIT-licensed.
